advisory.finding: No test pins the documented 'strictly narrower' narrowing of the legacy grandfather: a pre-330c attestation whose checkbox STATE is flipped after signing (no text edit) still reads stale-material, because _legacy_material_ok matches only a byte-identical (box-state-included) legacy recompute. Both negative controls (test_completion_real_edit_still_stale_material_despite_fallback, test_plan_review_real_edit_still_stale_material_despite_fallback) mutate item TEXT, which would fail even the normalized check — so neither exercises the box-flip boundary that distinguishes the narrowed legacy path from the normalized path.
